_doc: River & sea as a way of life (systems/riverBoats.js, systems/riverLife.js; the panel ui/actionMenu/riverLife.js; flood water on the street map ui/innerMapLayers/floodWater.js). boats: what the boatwrights of a river town build (price in gold, paid into the town's purse; hold: units of cargo it carries; hexDays: days to pole or row one hex on slack water — a lake, or across a river's run; down/up: that times this going with the current or against it; flood: the extra factor on both while the river is in flood (up is worse, down quicker); sellBack: share of the price a town's boatwright pays back, out of the town's purse). tolls: what a boat pays passing a town's mill weir and bridge (weir, bridge, in gold; perHold: extra gold per 40 units of hold, so a barge pays more), to the town's purse; owed in kind from the hold when the purse is empty.

punt.name: Punt
punt.desc: A flat-bottomed punt poled along the shallows: cheap, handy, and a fair load of goods.

barge.name: River Barge
barge.desc: A broad-beamed barge with a mast to step and a tow rope for the hard pulls upstream: slow against the current, a warehouse on the water going with it.

_docFishing: Fishing as a trade. leaseDays: how long a lease of fishing rights runs. fee: gold for a lease, by water (river, lake, sea), times townMult by the size of the town that holds the water (else the crown's rate crownMult); paid to the town's purse (or the crown's treasury). rollBonus: extra chances a day for a fish in a net set on water you hold the rights to (the good pools). bailiff: on water a town or a crown holds, a net set without a lease may be found (chance a day; near a town townMult times it): fined (fine gold, to the holder) or, with no coin, the net taken. poach: rival fishers empty part of a net's catch (chance a day, times leasedMult on water you hold, townMult near a town; share of the fish taken) — the fish go to the nearest town's market. fresh: days raw fish keep in your packs or a boat's hold, by season; then they rot. salt: one salt cures saltPer raw fish into preserved fish. waterside: how much more fish a market by a river, lake or the sea eats than an inland one (data/markets.json watersideDemand).
_docFloods: Spring floods. In spring (dayFrom..dayTo of the season) each river hex may rise: chance a day x (1 + its upstream size ^ 0.5 / sizeDiv) x rainMult in rain, stormMult in a storm (snowmelt early in the season: thawMult on days up to thawDays). A flood lasts days [min, max] and its crest runs downstream crest hexes, a day a hex, a little lower each time (fall). maxActive: the most hexes in flood at once. While a hex is in flood: nets there are washed away (washAway x severity, else torn), growing crops on it drown (drown x severity), a let house in a town on it takes repairDays of repairs (houseChance x severity), the town's granary loses grainLoss x severity of its grain, and the river brings down surge extra finds. The street map of a flooded hex shows the river over its banks: bankCells cells of water beyond the banks at full severity.
